list.snippet: Rarity / Number: Double Rare (#84/130 in Phantasmal Flames; #72 in Inferno X), with Special Art Rare (SAR) variants available.
Gale Thrust (Cost: 1 Colorless Energy) – Deals 60+ damage. If this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn, it deals 170 more damage (total 230 damage).
Spiky Hopper (Cost: 2 Colorless Energy) – Deals 160 damage. This attack's damage is not affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

Bench-to-Active Synergy: The deck relies heavily on switching mechanics (such as Jet Energy or movement effects) to get Mega Lopunny ex moving from the bench to the active spot to trigger the full 230-damage Gale Thrust for a low energy cost.
Partner Cards: Commonly paired with engine or utility Pokémon like Dunsparce, Mew ex, or poison packages (Pecharunt and Brute Bonnet).
Tournament Play: You can track competitive deck lists and usage stats on Limitless TCG. Current ungraded and graded market values are tracked on PriceCharting.
